subject: Request: temporary SLA carveout & escalation plan for AtlasCorp migration
messages:
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@atlascorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlascorp.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary SLA carveout for scheduled migration

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from our SRE and release teams — we have a planned cross-region migration for AtlasCorp between 10pm PDT on Aug 30 and 4am PDT on Aug 31. During the window there will be a brief period of degraded routing while we cut traffic and validate KV-cache warming.

Can Redwood approve a temporary modification to our Support Response SLAs for that window? Specifically: 
- P1 (priority): increase response objective from 15 minutes to 30 minutes for 22:00-04:00 PDT on Aug 30-31
- P2: increase from 1 hour to 3 hours for the same window

We'd also like a confirmed on-call contact for escalation (primary SRE contact will be Samantha) and a fall-through path to Redwood engineering if we see repeated timeouts. Attaching the migration schedule and a draft SLO amendment for your review.

If possible we'd prefer a unilateral confirmation by EOD Aug 29 so we can lock our runbook. Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Ethan
SRE Manager, AtlasCorp

Attachments: atlas_migration_schedule.xlsx, proposed_slo_amendment_v1.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@atlascorp.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlascorp.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA carveout for scheduled migration

Ethan — thanks for the heads up and the clear scope. We can accommodate a temporary carveout but need internal sign-off on the escalation ladder and a proposed credit/compensation if response objectives are missed during the maintenance window.

High-level response:
- We can approve the P1->30min and P2->3hr window for 22:00-04:00 PDT Aug 30-31 as a time-limited amendment tied to the attached runbook.
- We'll require Redwood on-call handoff details and a single engineering escalation contact (we need both primary and secondary).
- We'll propose a standby credit (single-day pro-rata) if the modified objectives are triggered more than twice during the window.

I'm looping in Ben (Support Ops) and Marissa (Customer Success) to finalize on-call coverage and Monica (CS lead) for contractual/credits. Can you confirm Samantha's mobile and whether you'll be using a Canary traffic shift or full cutover?

I'll follow up with the internal approval chain within a few hours.

— Jordan
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA carveout for scheduled migration

Team — forwarding AtlasCorp's request. Key asks: 30m P1 / 3h P2 overnight for Aug 30-31, single primary SRE contact (Samantha), and a defined escalation path into Redwood engineering. Attachments in original email.

Questions for decision:
- Ben: can Support Ops staff a standby overnight escalation (split-shift) for the 22:00-04:00 PDT window? If not, what's the minimal coverage we can commit to?
- Marissa / Monica: can we offer a one-time standby credit and tie acceptance to the signed amendment (DocuSign)? What's the approval needed to commit to a pro-rata credit?
- All: confirm primary and secondary escalation contacts and phone numbers.

Proposed internal plan:
1) Redwood provides standby responder (remote) staffed by Ben's team 22:00-04:00 PDT. Primary contact Samantha -> if no ack in 10 minutes escalate to Ben (support lead) -> if no ack in 30 minutes escalate to Jordan -> engineering on-call (Monica to coordinate a specific ENG phone chain).
2) Offer a standby credit equal to one day of monthly usage pro-rata if the temporary objectives are exceeded more than twice during the window.

I know this is a sensitive operational change; please reply with availability and approvals ASAP — AtlasCorp needs confirmation by EOD.

— Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA carveout for scheduled migration

Jordan / team — I can staff a single on-call responder remotely for the 22:00-04:00 window. It'll be a split-shift from our evening triage pool; the person will own initial P1 ack/triage and escalate per the ladder. Notes:
- We can commit to the 30m P1 ack and 3hr P2 ack for that window, but that reduces our spare capacity if anything else spikes — we should document fallback to the dedicated engineering hotseat if we see repeated incidents.
- I approve the standby credit language (one day pro-rata) but need Marissa/Monica sign-off to include it in a DocuSign amendment.
- I'll prepare an oncall_roster_aug29-31.csv with the assigned rep and contact numbers and drop it in the Drive link.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@atlascorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@atlascorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA carveout for scheduled migration — confirmed

Ethan — thanks for the details and patience. AtlasCorp: Redwood can confirm the temporary SLA amendment for 22:00-04:00 PDT on Aug 30-31 with the following conditions (please review):

1) Operational amendment (time-limited): P1 response objective -> 30 minutes; P2 -> 3 hours for the specified window only.
2) On-call coverage: Redwood will provide a staffed standby responder (Ben's assigned rep) during the window. Primary escalation: Samantha Ortiz (AtlasCorp SRE) -> Ben Carter (Redwood support lead) -> Jordan Blake (Director, Customer Reliability) -> Engineering hotseat (Monica will provide ENG contact chain).
3) Compensation: If modified objectives are missed more than twice in the window, AtlasCorp will receive a pro-rata standby credit equal to one day of monthly committed usage.
4) Sign-off: This agreement is contingent on a signed DocuSign amendment by 20:00 PDT Aug 30 referencing DocuSign: 0a7b-Atlas-SLA-amendment.

Required from AtlasCorp: confirm Samantha's mobile number and whether you'll use a Canary traffic shift or full cutover (we prefer Canary for reduced risk). Once we get your confirmation we will upload the on-call roster and finalize the DocuSign.

Next steps: 
- AtlasCorp confirms mobile & cutover style in reply (cc'd).
- Redwood uploads the oncall_roster_aug29-31.csv to the Drive link and sends DocuSign.

If you'd like a 15-minute sync I'll make time this evening.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: oncall_roster_aug29-31.csv (will be posted to drive)
